name: Metal Fabricators Plus
old_description: With over 40 years of combined experience John and Jason are the guys you've been looking for no mater what size project, big or small.  They can take your idea and make it a reality.  Jason Specializes in Design work and the Water Jet.  While John specializes in all things welding.
about:
Metal Fabricators Plus operates from Indianapolis, Indiana. The business was established by John and Jason, who together bring 40 years of combined experience in welding and fabrication. While the exact founding year is not disclosed, the partners have built the shop around their complementary specialties: Jason focuses on design work and water‑jet cutting, while John handles all welding operations. They describe their approach as taking a customer's idea and turning it into a finished part.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including metal cutting, metal forming, welding, laser cutting, and water‑jet cutting. Design assistance is also offered in‑house. No details on facility size, headcount, or annual volume are published.

The company does not specify target industries or customer types in its published content. It positions itself as able to handle projects of any size, from small jobs to large fabrications.

According to the owners, their combined experience enables them to deliver the lowest price at the highest quality with the shortest possible turnaround time.
